name: Exposure, artifact, method and prior-work audit
fixed_scope: Existing files; no new target predictions
outputs: Exposure registry; raw-result inventory; estimand and baseline dictionary; closest-method comparison
closure_rule: Resolve versions and label all unresolved evidence

name: Source-only primary schema and shortcut comparison
fixed_scope: Captures 1,3,8; two schemas; three source-held-out folds
outputs: Confusion matrices; balanced accuracy; recall; FPR; AUROC; shortcut models
closure_rule: Select only by frozen source rule; stop method branch if infeasible

name: View feasibility and dependence
fixed_scope: Same folds and schemas as E2
outputs: Per-view class performance; missingness; disagreement; joint errors; dependency graph
closure_rule: Require at least two eligible views; no guarantee of target competence

name: Monitor calibration, abstention and stress controls
outputs: Agreement ablations; prevalence/order stress; error-coverage; logic fixtures; frozen estimator
closure_rule: No target-label access; no threshold selected using held-out results

name: Packet engineering and final protocol freeze
outputs: Packet validity; effective exposure; mapping; view-impact matrix; target roster and hashes
closure_rule: Freeze both held-out targets and all choices before their outcome inspection

name: Held-out natural-shift monitoring
fixed_scope: Two eligible exposure-audited targets; natural-order and balanced secondary panels
outputs: Per-target primary outcomes; estimates; absolute error; signed bias; coverage
closure_rule: Evaluate every selected target; do not replace collapsed targets
compute_type: At most two accepted identity extractions; reuse in E7

name: Held-out fixed packet intervention
fixed_scope: Two targets x identity,k1,k3; shared extraction across seeds
outputs: Paired damage/error; mapping coverage; changed features; matched retained-pair comparisons
closure_rule: No selection by outcome; null interventions cannot prove damage monitoring

name: Existing tabular validity and target-matched replay
outputs: Projection-null control; budget/coordinate/row audit; bank/member errors; target-matched estimator
closure_rule: Correct or exclude invalid results; recover only affected missing conditions
compute_type: Post-processing; bounded regeneration only if needed

name: Theory, mechanisms and statistical analysis
fixed_scope: Accepted E2-E8 outputs; no new domains
outputs: Conditional bounds; weight/pseudo-label diagnostics; capture-level summaries; ROC exclusions
closure_rule: No seed/window pseudoreplication; distinguish source competence from target guarantees

name: Resource measurements and clean-start reproduction
outputs: Warm-up plus30 timed repeats; storage; memory; timing scope; fresh-process tables; claim ledger
closure_rule: All retained tables reproducible; unresolved evidence removed or narrowed
